notes: Residual Effectiveness v2 on the same K = 9 labels: b = B(h) is the BEFORE logit, e = G(h, r) the response effect, P(success | h, r) = sigmoid(b + e), delta = sigmoid(b + e) - sigmoid(b). G starts at 0, so training starts from P(success | h, r) = P(success | h). Loss: BEFORE binomial NLL + AFTER binomial NLL + ranking.lambda * same-history pairwise ranking loss (AFTER pairs whose rollout rates differ by at least 2/9) + residual.regularization * mean(e^2). B is trained by the BEFORE labels; in the AFTER terms b enters without gradient.

predictor.pilot_decision: 2026-10-01 user decision: train a residual predictor (B(h) + G(h, r)) as Effectiveness v2 and compare it with v1 (LoRA epoch 3 + temperature)

training.training_notes: learning_rate is the rate of both heads, lora_learning_rate the adapter rate. The B head starts from the frozen-backbone baseline's head; the G head starts at zero. Batches hold whole histories. Every epoch's checkpoint is kept (epochs/), with best (DEV NLL) and best_ordering. regularization 0.01 and the two learning rates are first values, not tuned.
